fusions.name: Trailing Gulls
fusions.desc: Sends 3 gulls at once, spread apart out to 7 tiles, each dealing 6 damage. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Yardarm Stoop
fusions.desc: Dives onto a target up to 7 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Wing and Wing
fusions.desc: Moves you 3 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Albatross Astern
fusions.desc: A bonded albatross fights beside you, striking an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
